literal_meaning: আদি (প্রাথমিক বা মূল) রস (অর্থাৎ সারাংশ বা সত্ত্বা)
figurative_meaning_en: The essence of carnal desire and love; erotic sentiment
example_sentences_in_english: Her poetry touches the essence of desire.
Desire drips from the gaze in his eyes.
history: Derived from classical Indian aesthetics in Natya Shastra, adapted in Bengali literature to denote the primordial erotic flavor.
note: This term is rooted in Sanskrit poetics and is commonly used in Rabindra Sangeet and modern Bengali romantic expressions.
